description: This file defines a custom exception class 'RoleAssociatedException' used in the user administration module of the Fineract platform to indicate when a role is associated with users. It extends a platform-specific abstract exception class.

classes.name: RoleAssociatedException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating a role is associated with users, preventing certain operations like deletion.

methods.name: RoleAssociatedException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with an error code and role ID, setting a specific message indicating the role is associated with users.

calls: super(errorcode, "Role with identifier " + id + " associated with users", id)
